customizerPage.tipsIntro: A few small adjustments can make a huge difference to how your cat sits on the YouTube progress bar. Here are the tweaks that have the biggest payoff.
customizerPage.tip1Title: Match the cat to your videos
customizerPage.tip1Desc: Pixel cats and chiptune-style GIFs feel right at home on retro gaming videos and lo-fi music streams. The classic Nyan Cat works on anything; the kawaii cats lean playful and cute. Try a few — switching is instant.
customizerPage.tip2Desc: A 16–24 px height feels subtle and disappears into the player. Push it to 40–60 px and the cat becomes the centerpiece. There's no wrong answer — pick what makes you smile when you scrub.
customizerPage.tip3Title: Use top offset to centre the cat
customizerPage.tip3Desc: Different GIFs have different padding around the animation, so the cat may sit too high or too low by default. Nudge the top offset by a few pixels until the cat's feet line up with the YouTube scrubber line.
customizerPage.tip4Desc: GIFs that include a flat coloured background will show that colour on the scrubber. Transparent-background GIFs blend cleanly with the YouTube UI. Most search tools let you filter for transparent results.
customizerPage.useCasesIntro: Different people find their cat in different ways. Here are three patterns we hear from users most often.
customizerPage.useCase1Desc: Lectures, podcasts, tutorials, and documentaries: a cat moving across a 40-minute progress bar is a tiny bit of motion that makes long-form videos feel less static. Many users pick a calm, walking-style cat for this.
customizerPage.useCase2Desc: YouTube Music users tend to pick dancing or bouncing cats — Orange Dance, Kitty Wigglez, and the Nyan classic are all perennial favourites. The motion syncs naturally with the music.
customizerPage.useCase3Desc: Streamers and people who share their browser on Zoom often pick a single bold cat (Garfield, Pixel Tiger) so the scrubber is a visible piece of branding. A few even upload a custom GIF that matches their channel.
customizerPage.faqHintPre: Most installation and customization questions are answered on the
customizerPage.faqHintPost: — take a quick look there first.

extension.heading: Obtenha o Nyan Progress Bar
extension.description: Extensão do Chrome gratuita. Instala em segundos e funciona imediatamente no YouTube.
extension.feature1Desc: Um clique na Chrome Web Store, sem necessidade de conta.
extension.feature2Desc: Completamente local. Sua atividade no YouTube permanece privada.
extension.feature3Desc: Mude a qualquer momento no popup, sem recarregar a página.

extension.questionPost: ou abra um relatório de bug.
extension.whyBody1: YouTube's default progress bar is a flat red line — useful, but easy to ignore. Nyan Progress Bar replaces that line with a hand-picked animated cat (or any GIF you choose) so the scrubber becomes a tiny piece of personality you actually notice. It's a small joy in your day, every video you watch.
extension.whyBody2: It's built for the people who live on YouTube: long-form videos and lectures, music and lo-fi playlists on YouTube Music, daily news, gaming streams, and creative work. The cat moves with the playhead, never gets in the way of the video, and is gone the moment you uninstall.
extension.whyBody3: And because the extension runs entirely in your own browser — no accounts, no servers, no analytics — there is nothing to sign up for and nothing to worry about. You install it, you forget it's there, and your videos just feel a little more yours.
extension.howStep1Desc: Add Nyan Progress Bar from the Chrome Web Store. The extension is ~15 KB, ships as Manifest V3, and asks only for access to YouTube and YouTube Music.
extension.howStep2Desc: Open the popup and tap any of the 12 built-in cats — or drop in your own GIF. The selection saves locally and syncs across every YouTube tab you have open.
extension.howStep3Desc: Use the height and top-offset sliders to make your cat sit perfectly on the scrubber. Settings are per-cat, so each theme remembers its own look.
extension.comparisonBody: Other browser extensions for YouTube focus on ad-blocking, sponsor skipping, or theme tweaks. Nyan Progress Bar is the only one purpose-built for the progress bar — every cat is hand-tuned for the YouTube scrubber's height and motion, with sane defaults so you don't fiddle with sliders unless you want to. The result is a single small, polished detail that doesn't fight the rest of YouTube's UI.

support.heading: Apoie o projeto
support.description: O Nyan Progress Bar é gratuito e de código aberto. Se você curtiu, considere me pagar um café — ajuda a manter os gatos alimentados e a extensão atualizada.
support.thankYou: Obrigado a todos que apoiaram o projeto 🐱✨

support.whereIntro: Nyan Progress Bar is a free side project, but it isn't free to run. Every contribution — no matter the size — goes directly back into keeping the extension alive and growing.
support.whereItem1Desc: The website, Chrome Web Store listing assets, and the contact-form email pipeline all cost a small but steady amount every month. Your support keeps the lights on.
support.whereItem2Desc: Designing and animating a new cat theme — or building a new customization control — takes hours of careful work. Donations pay for that time so the catalogue keeps growing.
support.whereItem3Desc: Chrome's extension APIs evolve constantly, and YouTube's player ships changes that occasionally break the scrubber overlay. Support funds the maintenance work that keeps everything running.
support.otherWaysIntro: Not in a position to donate? No problem — there are plenty of free ways to give the project a boost.
support.otherWay1Title: Leave a Chrome Web Store review
support.otherWay1Desc: Reviews are the single biggest signal that helps other people discover the extension. Even a one-line rating makes a real difference.
support.otherWay2Desc: Know someone who lives on YouTube? Send them the link. Word of mouth has been our biggest source of new users.
support.otherWay3Desc: Every bug report and feature request shapes the next release. Use the contact form or open a GitHub issue — both go straight to the maintainer.
support.otherWay4Desc: The project is open source. Pull requests for bug fixes, translations, or new cat designs are very welcome.
support.transparencyBody: There are no paid tiers, no premium cats, and no ads inside the extension. The product is the same for everyone — donations are entirely a way to say thanks and keep the cats running.

privacy.heading: Política de Privacidade
privacy.intro: O Nyan Progress Bar («nós», «nosso» ou «nossa») opera tanto um site quanto uma extensão do Chrome. Esta Política de Privacidade explica quais informações são coletadas, como são usadas e quais são seus direitos.
privacy.s1Body: O site usa o Google Analytics e o Google Tag Manager para coletar estatísticas de uso anonimizadas (páginas visitadas, duração da sessão, localização em nível de país). Nenhuma informação de identificação pessoal é coletada via análise. Os dados são processados pela Google LLC de acordo com sua política de privacidade.
privacy.s1OptOutPre: Você pode optar por não participar instalando o
privacy.s1OptOutLink: complemento de desativação do Google Analytics
privacy.s2Body1: A extensão funciona inteiramente no seu navegador e não coleta, transmite ou armazena nenhum dado pessoal em servidores remotos. Os únicos dados salvos são o tema de gato selecionado e qualquer GIF personalizado que você enviou — ambos armazenados localmente via Chrome Storage API no seu dispositivo.
privacy.s2Body2: A extensão requer acesso ao youtube.com e music.youtube.com para injetar o scrubber de gato no player de vídeo. Ela não lê nem registra seu histórico de visualização, consultas de pesquisa ou qualquer outra atividade do YouTube.
privacy.s3Body: Quando você envia o formulário de contato, seu nome, endereço de e-mail e mensagem são enviados para nossa caixa de entrada de suporte por e-mail. Esses dados são usados exclusivamente para responder à sua solicitação e não são compartilhados com terceiros.
privacy.s3Rights: Você pode solicitar a exclusão do seu envio a qualquer momento enviando-nos um e-mail.
privacy.s4Body: O site armazena sua preferência de tema (escuro/claro) localmente no navegador. Não definimos cookies de rastreamento. O Google Analytics pode definir seus próprios cookies de acordo com os termos do Google.
privacy.s5Intro: O site integra os seguintes serviços de terceiros:
privacy.s5Item1: Google Analytics / Google Tag Manager — análise de uso anonimizada
privacy.s5Item2: Ko-fi, Patreon, Donatello — plataformas de doação (os próprios termos se aplicam)
privacy.s5Body: A extensão do Chrome não se comunica com nenhum serviço externo.
privacy.s6Body: Os dados do Google Analytics são retidos por 14 meses. Os envios do formulário de contato são mantidos pelo tempo necessário para resolver sua solicitação. Os dados da extensão (tema de gato, GIF personalizado) são armazenados localmente e excluídos quando você desinstala a extensão.
privacy.s7Body: Esta política pode ser atualizada de tempos em tempos. A data de «última atualização» no topo desta página reflete a revisão mais recente.

install.title: Como instalar o Nyan Progress Bar
install.summary: Adicione a extensão ao Chrome em três cliques e veja o gato no YouTube imediatamente.
install.intro: O Nyan Progress Bar é uma extensão gratuita do Chrome disponível na Chrome Web Store. A instalação leva menos de um minuto.

steps.heading: Abra a página na Chrome Web Store
steps.body: Visite a página do Nyan Progress Bar na Chrome Web Store. Você também pode acessá-la clicando em "Instalar no Chrome" neste site.

steps.heading: Clique em "Adicionar ao Chrome"
steps.body: O botão azul fica no canto superior direito. O Chrome exibirá um aviso de permissões — a extensão solicita apenas acesso ao youtube.com e music.youtube.com.

steps.heading: Confirme a instalação
steps.body: Clique em "Adicionar extensão" no diálogo. A extensão é baixada (cerca de 15 KB) e instalada automaticamente. O ícone do Nyan aparece na sua barra de ferramentas.

steps.heading: Abra o YouTube e aproveite
steps.body: Acesse youtube.com e inicie qualquer vídeo. O gato aparece na barra de progresso imediatamente. Altere-o a qualquer momento no popup.

install.outroLink: Escolha o tema do seu gato

choose-cat.title: Como escolher um tema de gato
choose-cat.summary: Abra o popup, navegue na grade de gatos e escolha entre 12 temas integrados.
choose-cat.intro: A extensão vem com 12 temas de gatos ajustados à mão — do Nyan Cat clássico a um gato gordo dormindo, um gato pixel e variantes dançando.

steps.heading: Abra o popup da extensão
steps.body: Clique no ícone do Nyan na barra de ferramentas. Se não o ver, clique no ícone de quebra-cabeça e fixe o Nyan Progress Bar.

steps.heading: Navegue na grade de gatos
steps.body: A grade exibe os 12 gatos integrados e um bloco de upload para o seu GIF. Role para ver todas as opções.

steps.heading: Clique no gato desejado
steps.body: Toque em qualquer bloco para selecioná-lo. O bloco selecionado recebe uma borda e brilho ciano. A alteração é aplicada a cada aba do YouTube aberta.

steps.heading: Verifique no YouTube
steps.body: Alterne para uma aba do YouTube e mova a barra de progresso. Seu novo gato já está lá. O YouTube Music também é atualizado se estiver aberto.

choose-cat.outroPre: Quer usar um GIF que não está na grade?
choose-cat.outroLink: Faça upload do seu próprio GIF

upload-gif.title: Como fazer upload de um GIF personalizado
upload-gif.summary: Use qualquer GIF animado que encontrar online como scrubber do YouTube.
upload-gif.intro: Além dos 12 gatos integrados, você pode fazer upload de qualquer GIF como scrubber. O arquivo é armazenado localmente no navegador.

steps.heading: Encontre um GIF de que goste
steps.body: Navegue no GIPHY, Tenor ou Imgur. GIFs menores são mais ágeis no scrubber. Certifique-se de que o arquivo tenha extensão .gif.

steps.heading: Abra o popup da extensão
steps.body: Clique no ícone do Nyan. A grade aparece com um bloco de upload no canto superior esquerdo — borda tracejada com ícone + e texto "Fazer upload de GIF".

steps.heading: Clique no bloco de upload
steps.body: Um seletor de arquivo nativo abre, filtrado para .gif. Escolha o GIF baixado e confirme. A extensão armazena localmente e adiciona como novo bloco.

steps.heading: Seu GIF agora é o seu scrubber
steps.body: O GIF é selecionado automaticamente e enviado a todas as abas abertas do YouTube. Para trocar, clique no bloco de upload novamente.

upload-gif.outroPre: O GIF parece descentrado no scrubber?
upload-gif.outroLink: Ajuste a altura e a posição

adjust-position.title: Como ajustar a altura e a posição do gato
adjust-position.summary: Use os controles deslizantes no popup para ajustar como o gato se senta no scrubber.
adjust-position.intro: Cada gato tem tamanho e forma diferentes, por isso a extensão permite ajustar a altura e a posição vertical.

steps.heading: Selecione um gato primeiro
steps.body: Abra o popup e escolha o gato a ajustar. Os controles "Ajustar posição" só aparecem após a seleção.

steps.heading: Use o controle de Altura
steps.body: De 8 px a 80 px. Arraste e veja o gato redimensionar em tempo real.

steps.heading: Use o controle de Deslocamento superior
steps.body: De -50 px a +20 px. Negativos empurram o gato para cima; positivos para baixo.

steps.heading: Redefinir se necessário
steps.body: Clique em "Definir posição padrão" para redefinir ambos os controles. GIFs personalizados voltam a 28 px de altura e -13 px de topo.

adjust-position.outroPre: Quer visualizar os gatos antes de instalar?

about.heading: About Nyan Progress Bar
about.intro: Nyan Progress Bar is a free, open-source Chrome extension that replaces the flat red line on the YouTube progress bar with a hand-picked animated cat. This page is the short story of what it is, who builds it, and why it exists.
about.s1Body: Nyan Progress Bar is a small, focused browser extension for YouTube and YouTube Music. It does exactly one thing: it draws an animated cat (or any GIF you choose) on top of the video scrubber. There are no settings menus to learn, no accounts to create, and no subscriptions. You install it, you pick a cat, and that's the entire product.
about.s1Body2: Twelve cat themes ship out of the box, ranging from the original rainbow Nyan Cat to a pixel parrot, a glitchy chromatic cat, a dancing Garfield, and several minimal silhouettes. You can also upload any GIF from your computer to use as your own custom scrubber — the file stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.
about.s2Body: The project started as a personal frustration: spending hours every day on YouTube, looking at the same flat progress bar, and thinking it could be a tiny moment of joy instead. The classic Nyan Cat seemed like the obvious first cat to try, and once it was running on a real YouTube video it was clear that there was a small but meaningful pleasure to it.
about.s2Body2: Everything since has been driven by a simple idea: a browser extension can be calm, focused, and delightful. Most extensions ask for too many permissions, show too many UI surfaces, or try to monetize attention. Nyan Progress Bar deliberately does none of that — it's a tiny utility that adds one small smile to your day, and then it gets out of the way.
about.s3Body: Under the hood, the extension is a Manifest V3 Chrome extension that runs only on youtube.com and music.youtube.com. When a YouTube page loads, the extension finds the progress bar element and overlays your chosen GIF on top of it. The GIF moves with the scrubber position because it's anchored to the same element YouTube uses for the playhead.
about.s3Body2: Your cat selection, height, and top-offset values are saved locally using the Chrome Storage API on your own device. Nothing is uploaded to a server. The extension does not make any network requests; it does not read your watch history, your search queries, or anything else about your YouTube usage. If you uninstall the extension, every trace of it disappears with it.
about.s4Body: Nyan Progress Bar is built and maintained by an independent developer who works on it in their spare time. The project is open source — pull requests for new cat designs, translations, and bug fixes are very welcome, and the contact form on this site goes directly to the maintainer.
about.s4Body2: The site is translated into ten languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Polish, Ukrainian, Indonesian, Vietnamese, and Filipino) so users around the world can read about the extension in their own language.
about.s5Intro: A few principles guide how we build and run the project:
about.s5Item1: Privacy first. The extension does not collect or transmit data — period.
about.s5Item2: Ad-free inside the extension. There are no upsells, no premium cats, no subscriptions.
about.s5Item3: Open and transparent. The codebase, donations, and roadmap are all out in the open.
about.s5Item4: One small thing done well. We will never expand into ad-blocking, sponsorship-skipping, or general YouTube tweaks. The progress bar is the product.

faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Quick answers to the questions we get most often. Can't find what you're looking for? The contact form is one click away.
faq.stillStuckPost: — every message goes straight to the maintainer and gets a personal reply.

isFree.a: Yes. The Extension is completely free with no paid tiers, no premium cats, and no in-extension ads. The project is supported entirely by optional donations via Ko-fi, Patreon, Donatello, and others — see the Support page for details.

browsers.a: The Extension officially supports Chrome 88 and later. It also works on Chromium-based browsers including Microsoft Edge, Brave, Opera, Arc, and Vivaldi. A Safari port is on the roadmap. Firefox is not currently supported.

howToInstall.a: Visit the Chrome Web Store listing for Nyan Progress Bar and click "Add to Chrome". Confirm the install in the dialog and the cat appears on YouTube immediately — no reload, no sign-in. For a full walkthrough, see the install guide in the Guides section.

worksOnYouTube.q: Does it work on YouTube and YouTube Music?
worksOnYouTube.a: Yes — both. The Extension activates on youtube.com and music.youtube.com. It works in the standard player, the mini player, and the theatre mode. It does not run on any other website.

uploadGif.q: Can I upload my own GIF?
uploadGif.a: Absolutely. Open the Extension popup, click the upload tile in the cat grid, and pick any GIF from your computer. The Extension reads the file locally and uses it as your scrubber. The GIF is never uploaded to a server.

gifFormats.a: The Extension supports animated .gif files. Static images and other animated formats (APNG, WebP, MP4) are not supported. There is no strict size limit, but smaller GIFs (under a few hundred kilobytes) tend to feel snappier on the progress bar.

changePosition.q: How do I change the cat's size or position?
changePosition.a: Open the popup, pick a cat, and use the Height and Top offset sliders that appear. Height ranges from 8 px to 80 px; top offset from -50 px to +20 px. Settings are saved per-cat, so each theme remembers its own look.

catOffScreen.q: Why is my cat off-centre or off-screen?
catOffScreen.a: Different GIFs have different padding around the animation, so the default offset may not fit your custom GIF perfectly. Open the popup and nudge the Top offset slider by a few pixels until the cat lines up with the scrubber. If you over-adjust, click "Set default position" to reset.

doesItTrack.a: No. The Extension does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data. It does not read your watch history, your search queries, or any other YouTube activity. The only data saved is your cat selection and slider positions — both stored locally on your own device.

sendsDataAnywhere.q: Does it send anything over the internet?
sendsDataAnywhere.a: No. The Extension makes no network requests. Your GIF uploads and settings stay on your device. The website itself uses Google Analytics for anonymised traffic statistics — see the Privacy Policy for details — but the Extension is fully offline.

worksOffline.a: The Extension itself runs offline. YouTube videos obviously need an internet connection to play, but the cat overlay does not require any external connection of its own.

catNotShowing.q: The cat isn't showing up on YouTube. What do I do?
catNotShowing.a: First, refresh the YouTube tab — the Extension needs to inject the overlay on page load. If that doesn't help, make sure the Extension is enabled by visiting chrome://extensions and checking the toggle. If a recent YouTube player update has broken the overlay, please report it via the contact form so we can ship a fix.

extensionDisappeared.q: The Extension icon disappeared from my toolbar.
extensionDisappeared.a: Chrome may have unpinned it. Click the puzzle-piece icon next to your address bar to see all your extensions, then click the pin icon next to Nyan Progress Bar to bring it back to the toolbar.

uploadFails.a: Make sure the file has a .gif extension and is a true animated GIF (some "GIFs" on social media are actually MP4 videos with a misleading label). If the file is very large, try a smaller version — Chrome's local storage has limits. Otherwise, send a copy via the contact form and we'll take a look.

howToUninstall.q: How do I uninstall the Extension?
howToUninstall.a: Visit chrome://extensions, find Nyan Progress Bar, and click "Remove". All locally stored settings and uploaded GIFs are deleted automatically. If you have a moment, the short uninstall feedback form helps us improve the next release.
